productOnPage.title: Morris and the Magic Bell
productOnPage.author: Yoto
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Countdown to Christmas with Morris and Whitney as they journey to the North Pole to return Santa’s magic bell! No one loves Christmas more than Morris, and when the first day of December arrives, he simply cannot wait to start decorating! While sorting through his countless boxes of wreaths, lights, and ornaments, Morris discovers one item that doesn’t belong to him: a beautiful, perfectly round, shiny golden jingle bell. Morris knows each and every decoration in his collection by heart… so who could this bell possibly belong to? Morris deduces that it could be none other than Santa Claus himself, of course! Without this magical bell, Santa’s sleigh might not be able to fly… and Christmas could be ruined for everyone! Oh no!Being a very resourceful bear, Morris decides that – armed with his trusty Seeker Speaker directions device – he will travel the long and winding road to the North Pole to return the jingle bell directly to the big man himself. What could possibly go wrong?This holiday season, join Morris the bear, his new pal Whitney the rabbit, and the cast of characters they meet along their magical expedition. Go on zany antics, learn about different winter holiday traditions, find Santa Claus, and save Christmas for everyone! Tracks included: Introduction December 1st - Meet Morris December 2nd - Meet Whitney December 3rd - Why the Why December 4th - Block Tower December 5th - Argument December 6th - Elf Chase! December 22nd - The Gift December 23rd - Prep Day December 24th - Christmas Eve Credits
